verdict.rationale: Missive documents a public REST API with webhooks, UI integrations and custom channels on its developer docs. The changelog confirms drafts can be created through the API and an official MCP server, and the pricing page lists "API & MCP access", so the product can be driven programmatically. However, the evidence gives little detail on API scope, and the OpenAPI probe found no machine-readable spec. Missing for 10: published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, endpoint/auth/rate-limit detail in evidence, clarity on which plans include API access, independent or hands-on corroboration.
